integrity: Reproducible analytic proof is supplied with a finite Python corroboration; finite checks are not a universal proof. No independent validation or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected undirected weighted graphs; alpha,beta,kappa positive, 0<R<1; no claim for arbitrary holomorphic nonlinearities, global C^N basins or nonsymmetric networks. Linear spectral-gap prediction is acknowledged as earlier work. Historical priority remains conditional on the inspected literature.
title: Sharp invariant-disc threshold and optimal network synchronization for holomorphic hyperbolic-tangent flows
